results.issue: Ledgerが確認しているのは、治療後にB細胞が深く減少し、中央値約2か月後から再出現したこと。『B-cell activity（B細胞活性）を変える』は、細胞数の減少・再出現を超えて機能的活性の変化を示唆する新しい具体的主張である。
results.explanation: 体内でのCAR-T細胞生成とB細胞の一時的な減少・再出現は支持されるが、B細胞の機能的活性の変化はLedgerにない。

attempts.text: This study offers an early glimpse of a one-dose treatment that builds CD19 CAR-T cells inside the body and deeply depletes B cells, with B-cell re-emergence beginning at a median of about two months, across several difficult diseases.

This study offers an early glimpse of a one-dose treatment that builds CD19 CAR-T cells inside the body and deeply reduces B-cell levels, with B cells beginning to re-emerge at a median of about two months in participants with several difficult diseases.

results.final_text: This study offers an early glimpse of a one-dose treatment that builds CD19 CAR-T cells inside the body and deeply reduces B-cell levels, with B cells beginning to re-emerge at a median of about two months in participants with several difficult diseases.
results.point_context:
## In one line

This study offers an early glimpse of a one-dose treatment that builds CD19 CAR-T cells inside the body and temporarily changes B-cell activity across several difficult diseases. The signal is promising, but a lasting treatment effect still needs to be proven.
